methodology: Checked each non-duplicate catalogue row in 14 packages of 5–10 universities.
Used official university domains and linked official documents only.
Matched existing grants by direct university_id and grant_universities.
Absence from a checked page is recorded as unknown/not_found, never as no funding.
National/general mechanisms are excluded from NEW_RECORDS when a duplicate would be created.
Composite university groups retain target IDs in proposal records; no live links were changed.
